title: Authored mechanism closed-solid and non-joint collision audit
configuration: Educational 170 mm bore / 190 mm stroke / assumed 350 mm rod; not production Caterpillar CAD
coordinate_basis: 0.003 display units per nominal millimeter in the standalone authored rig. Embedded placement is a uniform presentation scale plus inferred axial layout.
topology_final_recheck: After the injector-bore/deck-outline repair and retirement of six redundant manual cylinder-section faces, all nine scene tests passed. Every educational hardware pickable now has an audited constituent solid range. The 718 physical constituent solids are unchanged by cap retirement.
boundary_sweep_pairs: each of twelve rods against all crank finish meshes
each rod against its corresponding piston finish meshes
boundary_sweep_scope: The original measured 721-pose sweep is preserved. The subsequent injector-deck aperture and manual-cap retirement changes do not alter any checked rod, piston or crank physical pair vertices. Head/deck geometry is outside these mesh pairs. Zero-length contact segments and segments shorter than 1e-7 display units are ignored.

clearances.basis: Nominal authored teaching geometry with 0.003 display units per millimeter; not OEM manufacturing clearances

methods.triangle_boundaries: three-mesh-bvh 0.9.15, SAH BVHs and ExtendedTriangle intersection segments; 721 integer-degree poses over the 720-degree cycle
methods.solid_closure: For each original primitive range in merged finish meshes, weld coordinates at 1e-6 display units, drop zero-area triangles and require two oppositely directed incident triangles per edge plus positive signed volume.
methods.retained_openings: Ray winding probes preserve the piston underside cavity, the two rod-bearing apertures, and the real injector deck bore. Seventy-two probes around the full injector body radius pass through deck material without containment.
methods.non_joint_separation: Actual crank solid axial intervals excluding shared crank pins remain disjoint from every rod; pure rotation about the shaft preserves this axial separation. Piston-relative rod vertices and clipped triangle-edge crossings remain inside the underside cavity across sampled phases.
methods.dependencies: Scratch-only three-mesh-bvh 0.9.15 and tsx; no application dependency was added.

joint_interpretation.crank_pin: A rod surrounds its shared journal with an annular bearing and positive radial gap; coincident joint centers are intentional, not a rod passing through a solid shaft.
joint_interpretation.wrist_pin: A shorter pin stays inside the underside cavity, passes through a real small-end bore, and is supported by annular piston bosses. It ends before the unbored skirt wall.
joint_interpretation.same_component_overlap: Connected details within a compound component can overlap as closed positive-winding solids. They are not a boolean-unioned manufacturing B-rep. Section caps use their nonzero winding union.

resolved: open liner half-torus and spring ends
wrist pin entering an unbored skirt
redundant manually positioned cylinder-study bed/crank section faces superseded by solid-winding caps
remaining_limits: No collision registration against purchased exterior bodies is established.
The 721-pose boundary sweep is discrete sampling, not a general swept-volume theorem.
The rendered closed valve disk/seat gap is approximately 0.0065 display units (2.17 nominal teaching mm); ideal event gating is not a modeled gas seal.
Cam/rocker actuation, production seat profiles, component fit, clearances, materials and load/contact forces remain illustrative.
Compound meshes retain internal constituent surfaces; closure is verified per constituent rather than claiming one manifold boolean union per component.
No OEM manufacturing-clearance, tolerance, stress or CFD validation is implied.
regression_tests: src/lib/scene/educational-mechanism.test.ts: 9 passing scene tests after final deck repair and legacy-cap retirement
src/lib/engine/mechanism.test.ts: 11 passing mechanism tests; unchanged by the final deck repair
